ENGLISH: China Set: Export Rail Vehicles Add-on
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 中国包：出口铁路载具附加包 {VERSION_STRING}

ENGLISH: The export rail vehicles sector of the China Set of OpenTTD.
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: OpenTTD中国包的出口铁路载具附加包。

ENGLISH: Locomotives, multiple units, coaches and wagons built for export. Includes broad gauge, metre gauge and gauge changing stock. More contents in the future.
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 为出口而建造的机车、动车组、客车和货车，包含宽轨、米轨和可变轨距车辆。未来会有更多内容。

ENGLISH: Adjust vehicle loading speed. Default is 100%.
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 调整车辆装载速度。默认为100%。

ENGLISH: Adjust vehicle purchase costs. Default is 25%.
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 调整车辆购买费用。默认为25%。

ENGLISH: Adjust vehicle running costs. Default is 25%.
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 调整车辆运营费用。默认为25%。

ENGLISH: Adjust cargo age period (the ability of keeping freshness of cargo and comfort for passengers) of coaches and wagons. Default is 100%.
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 调整车厢的货物贬值周期（旅客舒适度/货物保鲜度）。默认为100%。

ENGLISH: Cargo age period of mail and freight wagons
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 单独设置货车的货物贬值周期

ENGLISH: Set cargo age period of mail and freight wagons individually, multiplied by "Cargo age period" again. It makes very-long-distance transport of freight possible.
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 单独设置邮件车和货车的货物贬值周期，在选项"货物贬值周期"上叠加计算。

ENGLISH: Export stock built after a paint scheme change uses the new scheme
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 涂装换代后建造的出口车辆默认使用新涂装

ENGLISH: Choose whether a vehicle whose livery was changed mid-life is delivered in the new paint scheme automatically. Turning this off always uses the original factory scheme.
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 决定涂装换代期间建造的车辆是否自动使用新涂装。关闭后一律使用原始出厂涂装。

ENGLISH: This GRF needs dynamic_engines to be turned on. Open console, and type "set dynamic_engines 1".
SIMPLIFIED CHINESE: 请切换至控制台模式，键入 "set dynamic_engines 1"， 否则您无法游玩本附加包。
